Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the chase! India Women players are out there in the middle. Lizelle Lee and Laura Wolvaardt are the openers for South Africa Women. Meghna Singh to start for India Women. Here we go...
...THE RUN CHASE…

Now the target is a big one but the wicket is flat. South Africa do have a good batting line up but they’ll have to bat well. India on the other hand, will back themselves to defend this. Stay tuned for the second essay.

Shafali Verma is down for a chat. She says that she is happy with her knock and adds that she always thinks what the team wants. Tells that she was trying to time the ball against the seamers. Mentions that the run-out was a misunderstanding and it was not anyone’s mistake. She says that they have got a good score and hopes that their bowlers will do good job today.

The South African bowling was not up to the mark. They just let India score freely and there were far too many boundary balls. Shabnim Ismail and Masabata Klaas though were really good but the rest weren’t that great. They did well in the death overs though and restricted India under 280.

That is a really good batting display from India in a game that hey have to win. It was their openers who got hem going after a quick fire start. Shafali Verma got to her fifty before she was run out. Smriti Mandhana and Mithali Raj then continued but the former too fell shortly after her half ton. Harmanpreet Kaur however, along with Mithali Raj ensured there was no collapse and have taken their side to a superb total.
Single to end the innings! This is full on middle. Sharma drills it towards deep mid-wicket for just a single. India have ended with 274/7 after their 50 overs!
A low full toss on off. Rana drives it to mid off for a single.
A slower length delivery, on leg. Sharma works it to fine leg for a single.

OUT! BOWLED! Kaur departs and this has been a good performance by South Africa in the death overs. A length delivery on middle and leg. Kaur goes for a mighty swing across the line but misses. The ball shatters the stumps and it is an end of a decent knock by Kaur. Deepti Sharma is the next batter in.
A fuller delivery on middle. Kaur swings across the line. She gets the inside half of her blade and takes a couple towards deep backward square leg.
A perfect yorker on off. Kaur digs it out back to the bowler.

NOT OUT! Another decision overturned! This one is short again around middle and leg. Rana backs away and looks to pull it but misses. The ball goes back to the keeper and South African players appeal again. The umpire raises the finger again. However, Rana takes a review and replays show that there is no bat involved.
Lands on a length, on off. Rana drives it to covers.

NOT OUT! The umpire gave that out but Sneh Rana knew she had not got a bat on this one and reviews it straightaway. The UltraEdge confirms that there is no bat. This one is short and angling into the body. Rana looks to upper cut it but misses. The keeper collects the ball and they appeal. The umpire raises the finger but UltraEdge shows no bat involved. So Rana will continue.
Back of a length, outside off. Kaur dabs it towards third man for a single.
Sneh Rana is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Richa Ghosh departs as she fails to get the timing on that. Lands on a length, on off. It is probably a slower one. Ghosh looks to go big downtown. However, she gets the bottom of her blade and the ball goes very high in the air. Sune Luus runs behind it and settles under it to take a fine catch. This has been a good come back by Shabnim Ismail after going for runs in the first few overs.
Commentary.Howout: c Sune Luus b Shabnim Ismail

Commentary.Commentary: On the shorter side on off. Ghosh looks to ramp it towards the off side but misses.
Two Wides! A slower length delivery and down the leg side. Kaur looks to work it towards the leg side but misses. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and the batters steal a bye.
Shabnim Ismail is back on.
Single to end the over and 11 runs from it! A short ball, on middle. Kaur pulls it to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Two in a row now! A full delivery on middle. Kaur stays deep in her crease and slams it straight down the ground for a boundary.
FOUR! Finally a boundary for India, much-needed one! Back of a length, around off. Kaur waits for it and steers it through backward point for a boundary.
Dot ball! Nails a yoker, around off. Kaur makes room and looks to dig it out but misses.
Only a single again, India need more than this. A full delivery, around off. Ghosh drives it left of mid off for a single.
A short delivery, outside off. Kaur pulls it to deep mid-wicket for just a single.
Single to end the over and Kaur will retain the strike. A full delivery on middle. Kaur hits it hard to long on for a single.
Dot ball now! Back of a length, outside off. Kaur cuts it to point.
Just a single again! A length delivery on middle. Ghosh works it to deep square leg for a single.
A full delivery on middle. Kaur goes for a big slog across the line. However, she gets the inside edge of her blade to fine leg for a single.
On the shorter side on middle and leg. Ghosh pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Shorter delivery on middle. Kaur gets the bottom of her blade as she looks to pull it. The ball goes towards mid-wicket for a single.
This is fuller, aroun off. Ghosh drives it to covers.
Back of a length, around off. Ghosh cuts it to cover-point.

Ohh..just short of the fielder at deep mid-wicket. This is full on off. Kaur slog-sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there comes charging in and dives forward but fails to reach it. She probably got the fingers on it but fails to pouch it. A single taken.
This is fuller on off.  Ghosh makes room and drives it through extra-cover. The batters run three. Good running.
THREE WIDES! Ghosh backs away and Khaka follows her. She ends up bowling way down the leg side and Ghosh lets it go. The keeper misses it too and two byes are taken.
This is full on middle. Kaur paddle-sweeps it to fine leg for a single. Boundaries are not coming for India.
On a length, on middle. Ghosh works it to mid-wicket for a single.
Bangs it short on off. Ghosh pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
A slower full ball, outside off. Ghosh pushes it to covers.
This one is short on off. Ghosh looks to pull it but gets the bottom of her blade as hits it back to the bowler.
A full delivery on off. Ghosh drives it to covers.
Richa Ghosh is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! This is a big wicket as Pooja Vastrakar can be dangerous in the final overs. Shabnim Ismail bowls it full and offers no pace around off, Pooja Vastrakar drives but is early into the shot as she is deceived by the slower one. It goes in the air towards covers and Sune Luus takes an easy catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Sune Luus b Shabnim Ismail

Commentary.Commentary: Bangs this one short outside off. Pooja Vastrakar lets it go.

A quick single now! Direct hit and that would have been close! A full delivery on off. Pooja Vastrakar drives it to mid off and sets off for a single. Shabnim Ismail fires a throw at the bowler's end but misses. The replays show that Pooja Vastrakar was gone if that would have hit the stumps.
Bangs it short on middle. Kaur pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
WIDE! Another short delivery and down the leg side. Kaur lets it go as it is way down the leg side.
A slower short delivery, outside off. Kaur looks to pull it but misses.
Goes fuller on off. Pooja Vastrakar drives it left of mid off for a single. Great stop by Shabnim Ismail as she dives to her left and stops it.
Another dot ball! A length delivery on middle. Pooja Vastrakar defends it towards the leg side.
Back of a length, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar works it towards the leg side.
Lands on a length, on middle. Pooja Vastrakar works it right of mid on for a single.
A length delivery on middle. Pooja Vastrakar defends it back to the bowler.
Goes fuller on middle. Kaur works it to long leg for a single.
Pooja Vastrakar is the next batter in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Mithali Raj departs and Klass gets a wicket off a slower delivery! Might be a blessing in disguise for India. A slower length ball, on off. Raj looks to go big down town. However, she gets the bottom of her blade and the ball goes high in the air towards the mid off region. Chloe Tryon runs to her right and takes a good catch as she dives to her right. It has been a good knock from Raj but it is time for power-hitters to take over.
Commentary.Howout: c Chloe Tryon b Masabata Klaas

Commentary.Commentary: On off and fuller. Kaur steps down the track and sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
FOUR! Kaur knows she needs to get going now! A slower fuller delivery on off. Kaur gets under it and hits it towards cow corner for a boundary.
Kapp ends with a dot delivery! A slower length ball, outside off. Raj looks to push it towards the off side but mistimes it.
Short ball, on off. Kaur pulls it to fine leg for a single.
Serves a length delivery on middle. Raj works it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Another slower delivery on off. Kaur drags it towards deep square leg for a single.
A slower length delivery, around off. Raj steers it towards third man for a single. 50 partnership comes up.
Starts with a short delivery on off. Kaur pulls it to deep square leg for a single.
Marizanne Kapp is back on. She has given away 36 runs in her 6 overs so far.
Bangs it short on off. Kaur pulls it to deep square leg for a single. Just a single from the over, very good from Ismail.
Back of a length, around off. Kaur cuts it to point.
A short ball on middle. Kaur ducks under it.
Nice change of pace! A slower length delivery, around off. Kaur looks to push it but mistimes it.
Lands on a length, on off at 120 kph. Kaur dabs it towards the off side.
A slower length ball, around off. Kaur defends it towards the off side.
End of Powerplay 2! Now, 5 fielders can be placed outside the circle until the end of the innings.
Full again and on leg. Kaur paddles it to fine leg for a single. India would be looking around 300 and need to get going in these last 10 overs now.
This is full and down the leg side, very close to the leg stump. Kaur looks to paddle it but misses. The keeper fails to collect it too and two byes are taken behind the keeper.
A full delivery on middle. Kaur works it to mid-wicket.
Slower delivery, around off. Raj guides it square off the wicket on the off side for a single.
FOUR! This is what India need now! A length delivery on off. Raj gets under it and tonks it over mid off for a boundary.
A slower full toss on off. Kaur sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Another dot ball! A short ball on middle. Raj ducks under it.
Fuller on middle. Raj drives it to mid on for a single.
Another short delivery and angling into the body. Raj sways away from the line of the ball and looks to late cut it but misses.
Bangs it short on off. Kaur pulls it to deep backward square leg for a single.
Short and wide outside off. Raj cuts it to third man for a single.
A low full toss on leg. Kaur flicks it to deep square leg for a single.
Goes fuller on leg. Kaur works it to fine leg for a single. 7 runs from the over.
On the shorter side, around off. Raj steers it towards third man for a single.
Lands on a length, on off. Raj blocks it out.
FOUR! Another fine shot! This is fuller, around off. Raj drives it through cover-point with superb timing and the ball races away towards the fence.
Shorter delivery, around off. Kaur looks to pull it but mistimes it to mid-wicket for a single.
Goes fuller on off. Kaur drives it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Lovely shot! This is short and wide. Raj goes deep in her crease and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Fuller delivery on off. Kaur paddle-sweeps it and takes a single towards fine leg. 200 up for India!
Shorter and outside off. Kaur cuts it to point.
WIDE! This is full and down the leg side. Kaur looks to paddle-sweep it but misses.
Goes fuller on leg. Raj works it to deep square leg for a single.
Flatter and quicker on off. Kaur pushes it to covers for a single.
Fifty for Mithali Raj! Big game for India and the skipper has delivered. However, she needs to kick on from here. This is flatter on off. Raj pushes it to covers and takes a single.
Drifting on the pads. Raj works it right of mid-wicket and takes a quick single. Moves onto 49 now.
Sligthtly on the shorter side, slower delivery at 91 kph. Kaur cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Klaas goes fuller and outside off. Kaur drives it to point.
FOUR! Nice shot! Lands on a length, on off. Kaur goes down on her knee and sweeps it to deep square leg for a boundary. Kaur is key for India here.
Very full on middle. Kaur defends it towards mid on.
Goes fuller on off. Kaur drives it to mid off.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Top edge but safe! Kaur looks to sweep, this one has extra bounce. It goes off the top edge but lands safe in the square leg region for one.
Nicely played! This is outside off, Kaur manages to scoop it down to fine leg for two.
On off, kept out.
On off, this is eased down to long off for one.
FOUR! That is a gift and Raj gleefully puts it away! A full toss on the pads, it is swept down to the fine leg fence. Once again, after a good over, the pressure is released by a poor ball.
A single to end as this is eased through cover.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
On middle, kept out.
Three dots in a row now as this one is also played to cover.
Fuller again, this is hit to cover.
On off, this is driven to covers.
Pushed quicker on off. Raj drives it to covers.
Slower and fuller on off. Raj blocks it off the front foot.
Flatter and quicker around off. Kaur punches it to covers for a single.
Goes fuller outside off. Raj drives it to sweeper cover for a single.
Shorter and outside off. Kaur goes back and cuts it to deep cover for a single.
Slower in the air, on off. Kaur gets forward and defends it.
Harmanpreet Kaur is the next batter in.

OUT! TAKEN! That is an excellent catch from Tryon. A welcome wicket for South Africa as these two were really taking the game away. This is fuller and on off, seems like a slower one. Mandhana looks to loft it over mid off. She does not get it off the middle but it seems like she has got enough to clear mid off. Tryon there runs back and then dives and hangs on. She is ecstatic. End of a really good innings from Mandhana, her innings has set the platform for India to get close to 275. South Africa on the other hand will look to squeeze now.
Commentary.Howout: c Chloe Tryon b Masabata Klaas

Commentary.Commentary: Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
Another one on the fuller side. This is timed wonderfully through covers for one.
Fuller and on off, Raj pushes it through covers for one.
Outside off, Raj guides it to point.
A full nut on the pads, this is worked down to fine leg for one.

Drinks! India are going along nicely here. They slowed down a bit after two wickets in quick succession but this partnership is slowly picking up the pace and the foundation has been led for the big-hitters to unleash in the death overs. South Africa Women need wickets to restrict India to a par score here, otherwise the game can drift away from them in the final overs.
Two dots in a row! Something which has been rare in the recent overs! On middle, this is played to mid-wicket.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Fuller and on off, this is eased down to long off for one.
Good batting! Follows the boundary by guiding it towards point for one.
FOUR! Deft! Raj is into her elements now! Short and outside off, Raj waits and cuts it past point for another boundary.
On the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.
Two more! Shorter and on middle, Raj pulls it through square leg for two. Another big over for India.
FOUR! Exquisite! Kapp is leaking runs here. This though is a wonderful shot. It is a fullish ball outside off, Raj leans into it and creams it past the diving cover fielder and into the fence.
Up and over and two! Runs coming nicely now. Fuller and outside off, this is lofted over covers for two.
A rare dot in recent overs! On off, this is guided to point.
WIDE! This one is down the leg side. Wided.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
A direct hit and Mandhana was a goner! Shorter and outside off, it is guided straight to point. Raj calls for one. They go for it. The fielder has a shy but misses.
On off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Yet another one on the shorter side, it is hit through square leg for one.
Shorter and on the body, pulled yet again, the gap is found in the square leg region for two.
On the shorter side, outside off. Raj goes back and cuts it to deep cover for a single. 150 up for India!
Shorter and on middle, this is hit through square leg for one.
A full toss, on middle, Mandhana pulls it through square leg for two.
A single to end! On off, this is driven through covers for one. A really good over for India.

FOUR! Not sure if it was deliberately played! Pretty sure she did not want to get it that fine! Around off, Mandhana opens the face of the bat, it goes more off the outside edge past the keeper and down to the third man fence.
Yet another one outside off, Mandhana guides it to point.
Outside off, this is guided through point for one.
Shorter and on middle, Kapp pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! That is not a good start to the over and the spell from Kapp and she knows it. Down the leg side, it is worked fine and it races away to the fine leg fence.
FIFTY FOR MANDHANA! Really good innings from her in an important game. Needs to get a move on now but has to stay in there for longer. She gets there by easing it down to long off for one.
Mandhana moves onto 49! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg, in the gap, two taken.
Another one on the shorter side, this is pushed through covers for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
No maiden then! Two to end! Outside off, it is squeezed through point for two.
Sharp! Another short one. Raj maybe did not expect it. She gets out of the way at the end.
Good aggressive stuff! Short and on middle, Raj evades it.
Ismail is giving nothing away! On off, Raj guides it to point.
A yorker now on off, it is jammed out to point.
Outside off, Raj guides it to point.

What an effort that is from Mignon du Preez! Outstanding! Mandhana comes down the track, makes it into a full toss but it is dipping on her. She looks to loft it down the ground but it goes more off the bottom. Mignon du Preez at long off runs to her left and dives but it lands short. Long on does the mopping up job. Two taken.
A full toss now, Raj does not take full toll of it, she hits it along the ground through covers for one.
Raj misses out! Very slow and outside off, Raj cuts but to point.
Sees Mandhana come down the track, slows it up and bowls it shorter. It is pushed down to long off for one.
Short, slow and outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Mandhana eases it down to long off and takes one.
A dot to end! On off, it is kept out.
On middle, Raj works it to mid-wicket.
That is a really good change of pace! Outside off, Raj guides it to point.
On off, this is pushed to cover.
Outside off, left alone.
Angled into the pads, Raj looks to flick but misses to get hit on her pads. Half an appeal but turned down.
Shorter and on middle, Raj pulls it through square leg for one.
Two! Shorter and outside off, this is guided through point for two.
Chipped! Mandhana comes down the track but does not get to the pitch of it. She lobs it down to long off, it lands well short. One taken.
Outside off, this is pushed through covers for one.
On off, kept out.
On off, defended.
Sune Luus is into the attack now.
Good stuff from Ismail. Two short balls and now a yorker. Mandhana is up for it as she gets her bat down in time.
Kind of short now and angled away from off. Mandhana looks to pull but misses.
The physio is out to have a look. Mandhana is in a little pain.
That is a good bumper! Short and on the body. Mandhana looks to pull but misses. She gets hit on the arm and then it hits the helmet and lobs on the off side but lands safe.
On off, it is pushed to cover.
Outside off, Raj opens the face of the bat and guides it past point for one.
Ismail starts her new spell with a full one on off, it is pushed to cover.
Just like this! She retains strike as she rocks back and plays it through covers. This time there is a sweeper and rightly so, she is finding the gaps on the off side brilliantly.
The boundary then has been followed by three dots. Raj needs to rotate strike after striking it to the fence. On off, she plays a defensive stroke.
Another one tossed up and on middle, Raj pushes it back to the bowler.
On middle, Raj pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! Finds the gap well! Shorter and outside off, Raj cuts it through point. There are two fielders there but she places it well. It races away to the fence.
Shorter and on middle, this is pulled through square leg for one.
A dot to end but a decent over for India. Runs starting to come again. On off, this is pushed to cover.
On off, kept out.
What a shot that is! Fuller and on off, Raj strokes it through covers. She just plants her front foot forwards and caresses it away. Two taken.
Fuller and on off, this is pushed through covers for one.
Goes full and wide again outside off, just inside the tramline. Left alone.
Good placement! Outside off, Mandhana guides it through point. Wide of the sweeper for two.
WIDE! Very,  very wide outside off. Left alone.
A good recovery then by Tryon as she ends with 3 dots. On the stumps, this is pushed to cover.
Flattee and on the stumps, kept out.
Good comeback! On middle, defended.
FOUR! Gets it away this time. A gift and that releases the pressure that was building. 100 up for India. Down the leg side. This is swept fine and it races away to the fence.
Down the leg side. Raj looks to sweep but misses. She gets hit on the pads.
Fuller and on off, this is eased down to long off for one.
A maiden then! On off, blocked.
This is a good passage of play for South Africa. Another dot. On off, it is pushed to cover.
Kind of a misfield but no run! On off, fuller, it is driven to cover. The fielder fumbles but no run.
On the stumps again, kept out.
Good length and on off, it is pushed to covers.
Fuller and on off, this is eased through covers for one.
Shorter and on off, this is pushed to cover. A really good over form Tryon comes to an end.
Flatter and on middle, defended.
On middle, blocked.
Mithali Raj is the next batter in.

OUT! TIMBER! Bhatia goes now, two wickets in quick succession for South Africa and they are now back into this one. A very strange dismissal, kind of unfortunate for Bhatia. This is a full toss down the leg side. Bhatia looks to sweep. It dips at the very end, hits the back of her bat and then the stumps.
Well bowled! Full and wide outside off, Bhatia just opens the face of the bat at the end and plays it past point for two.
A full toss, it is eased down to long on for one.
Fuller and on off, Bhatia strokes it to covers.
Gets off strike! On off, this is pushed down to long off for one.
4 dots in a row then after the wide! Outside off, it is guided to point.
Amother dot! Fuller and on middle, this is driven nicely but to the bowler.
Fuller and on off, this is driven nicely but to covers.
Good length and on off, this is pushed to covers.
Looks to go for a yorker but slips this down the leg side. Mandhana looks to flick but is beaten.
Yastika Bhatia walks in at number 3.

OUT! RUN OUT! Ohh...big mix-up and Shafali Verma after playing a fantastic knock has to walk back! There was no other way she was going to give her wicket away in this game. South Africa Women will take a sigh of relief as the destructive opener has been sent back courtesy of a run out. Flatter delivery on middle. Smriti Mandhana works it calmly towards mid-wicket and looks for a single. However, Shafali Verma is late to react and is not even half-way down the track. Both are stranded in the middle at the end and then Shafali Verma walks across Smriti Mandhana and sacrifices her wicket for the senior partner. Sune Luus throws it to the keeper, Trisha Chetty and she whips the bails off. Big wicket for South Africa Women but a superb knock from the young gun.
Goes shorter, outside off. Verma punches it to deep cover for a single.
Slower in the air, around off. Verma defends it towards the off side.
Goes quicker on off. Verma defends it off the front foot.
Another flatter delivery on middle, Verma blocks it out.
Goes fuller on middle. Verma drives it back to the bowler.
SIX! What a shot! A length delivery, on off. In the slot and Smriti Mandhana tonks it over deep mid-wicket for a biggie.
Lands on a length, around off and angling across. Smriti Mandhana looks to cut it but misses.
This is slower and shorter outside off. Verma looks to cut it away but misses. The keeper fails to collect it cleanly and a bye is taken.
FOUR! That's how you get to a fifty! What a innings this has been in a crucial encounter. Goes fuller on off. Verma tonks it towards long on and one bounce into fence.
A low full toss on off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to mid off. A misfield there and a single is taken.
Klaas goes fuller on off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to short cover.
Flatter delivery on middle. Verma works it towards mid-wicket.
Goes fuller on middle. Smriti Mandhana sweeps it through backward square leg for a single.
Smriti Mandhana skips down the track and Chloe Tryon serves it bit short. Smriti Mandhana defends it.
A full toss on middle. Smriti Mandhana drives it back to the bowler.
A full delivery on middle. Verma drives it to long off for a single.
Slower in the air, around off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to long off for a single.
Just one from the over! A full delivery on off. Verma drives it to mid off.
Back of a length, around off. Smriti Mandhana steers it towards deep backward point for a single.
Slightly shorter and around off. Smriti Mandhana looks to cut but mistimes it to point.
A full delivery on off again. Smriti Mandhana drives it to cover-point again.
A low full toss, on off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to cover-point. Misses out on a run-scoring opportunity.
Starts with a full delivery on middle. Smriti Mandhana drives it to mid off.
Masabata Klaas is into the attack now.
Goes fuller on leg. Verma works it to mid-wicket.
On middle and fuller. Smriti Mandhana sweeps it to fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Excellent use of the feet from Smriti Mandhana! This is fuller around off. Smriti Mandhana shimmies down the track and lifts this over mid off for a boundary.
Fuller, around off. Verma drives it to long off for a single.
Slower in the air, on off. Verma drives it back to the bowler.
Goes fuller on leg. Verma clips it to square leg.

Powerplay 2 time. A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the ring till the 40th over. Ohh..the physio is out and Shafali Verma is getting some treatment on her left knee. She looks fine now and is ready to resume. Chloe Tryon is into the attack now.
Back of a length, on middle. Smriti Mandhana pushes it to mid on. 68 runs for Indian from the Powerplay 1, exactly what they needed in this crucial game.
Slower length delivery, outside off. Verma backs away and steers it towards third man for a single.
Back of a length, outside off. Verma steers it towards the deep backward point region for another couple.
Goes fuller on off. Verma gets across and scoops it towards long leg for a couple.
Goes fuller on leg. Smriti Mandhana works it to fine leg for a single.
Lands on a length, on middle. Slower delivery. Smriti Mandhana defends it back to the bowler.
Shabnim Ismail is back on. She has gone for 25 runs in her two overs so far.
FOUR! 13 from the over and this has been a superb knock so far! A fuller delivery, slower in pace. Verma waits for it and slams it past mid off for a boundary.
A length delivery, around leg. Smriti Mandhana works it towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Nice shot! Half-volley on off. Smriti Mandhana leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Smriti Mandhana looks to clip it but misses.
Goes aerial again. It is full and outside off. Verma lifts it over cover-point, not much timing again. A single taken.
A yorker around off. Verma blocks it out.
In the air..but over mid off. A fullish delivery, outside off. Verma looks to go big but gets the bottom of her blade. The ball goes in the air over mid off and gets a couple. 50 up for India.
FOUR! Now she finds the gap! A short delivery on off. Smriti Mandhana hangs back and picks the length quickly to pull it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Full again, around off. Smriti Mandhana drives but fails to find the gap again, this time towards point.
Another full delivery on off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to mid off.
Goes fuller outside off. Smriti Mandhana drives it crisply to covers.
Lands on a length, around off. Smriti Mandhana defends it towards mid off.
A fullish delivery, around off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to cover-point. Good stop there.
A full delivery on off. Verma drives it to mid off.
Pulls her length back, around off. Verma defends it towards backward point.
FOUR! She is in her groove and making South Africa pay here! Goes fuller outside off. Verma slams it left of mid off for a boundary.
Lands a length delivery, around off. Verma gets well forward and defends it.
Short and wide outside off again. Verma cuts but gets a thick outside edge towards third man for a couple.
Short and wide outside off. Verma cuts it to point.
Lands on a length, around off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards point. Dot ball again.
Pulls her length back, around off. Smriti Mandhana punches it to cover-point.
Overpitched delivery on middle. Smriti Mandhana drives it left of the bowler. Kapp gets a hand on it and half-stops it.
A good-length delivery, around off. Verma steers it towards third man for a single.
Drifting on the pads now. Smriti Mandhana works it to mid-wicket for a single.
This time fuller delivery, on off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to mid off.
WIDE! Full and down the leg side. Smriti Mandhana looks to work it towards the leg side but misses.
Slower delivery, outside off. Verma looks to drive it away but misses.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Verma takes a step forward again and looks to push it towards the off side but misses.
FOUR! Top-class batting! Serves a length delivery, around off. Verma skips down the track and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Lands a length delivery again, around leg. Verma defends it towards the leg side.
On a length, on middle and leg. Verma tries to work it towards the leg side but gets a leading edge towards the off side.
Khaka starts with a fullish delivery that shapes into the batter. On off and Verna defends it towards the off side.
Goes fuller on off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to mid off this time.
Back of a length, outside off. Smriti Mandhana cuts it to cover-point.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone.
A length delivery, on middle. Verma waits the ball to come to her and works it past square leg for a single.
Back of a length, around off. Smriti Mandhana punches it towards deep backward poiunt for a single.
A good-length delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana lets it go.
Goes fuller now, on middle. Verma works it towards mid-wicket. 17 runs from the over!
Back of a length, around off. Verma backs away and slaps it through covers for couple of runs.
NO BALL! A short delivery, around off. Verma ducks under it. Shabnim Ismail has overstepped and it will be a no ball. Free Hit coming up.
Back of a length, outside off. Verma steers it past point for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Another boundary. This is what this young girl can do! Length delivery, around off. Verma gets across and hits this towards the fine leg region for a boundary.

FOUR! Sublime timing! Lands a length delivery, around off. Verma waits for it and then just steers it through the backward point region for a boundary. The fielder at third man dives to her right but fails to stop it.
FOUR! SHOT! Poor delivery, full around leg. Verma tucks it fine towards long leg fence for a boundary.
Beaten again! Serves a good-length delivery, around off. Smriti Mandhana looks to drive it away but gets beaten off the outside edge.
Lands on a length and angles it across the batter, outside off. Smriti Mandhana goes pushing for it but misses.
Length delivery, around off. Smriti Mandhana blocks it out.
FOUR! Here we go...a trademark cover-drive from Smriti Mandhana! Low full toss, around off. Smriti Mandhana leans forward and drives it through covers for a boundary.
Overpitched delivery on middle. Smriti Mandhana drives it to mid off.
WIDE! Goes full again but way too wide outside off. Smriti Mandhana leaves it alone.
Starts with a very full delivery, outside off. Smriti Mandhana pushes it towards the off side.
Back of a length, around off. Verma dabs it towards the third man region and comes back for a couple. Smriti Mandhana was late to react for the second run but completes it easily.
Marizanne Kapp will start from the other end.
WIDE! Verma goes way across towards the off side and Ismail bangs this one short, outside off. Verma ducks under it. The umpire calls it wide for height.
Back of a length, outside off. Verma looks to guide it away towards the off side but misses.
FOUR! Lovely shot! Goes fuller on off. Verma gets a stride forward and creams a drive left of mid off for a boundary. She is off the mark in style.
Lands a length delivery on off. Verma blocks it out.
India and Smriti Mandhana are underway! Goes fuller on off. Smriti Mandhana drives it to covers for a single.
Starts with a good-length delivery on off. Smriti Mandhana defends it onto the turf calmly.

We are done with the national anthems. South Africa Women players are in the huddle before they disperse to take their respective positions. Shafali Verma and Smriti Mandhana are the openers for India Women. South African players will take knee while Indian players put their hand on their heart in support of Black Lives Matter movement. Shabnim Ismail to start with the ball. Here we go...

Time for national anthems! It will be South Africa's first followed by India's. This is a big game for India and they are missing the services of their most experienced bowler, Jhulan Goswami. However, Meghna Singh has been impressive in the tournament so far and can prove handy on this surface. They first need to bat well and put a big score to put this South African team under pressure.

W.V Raman and Sanjay Manjrekar are down with the pitch report. Sanjay Manjrekar says that the sun is out and it is the same pitch as yesterday. He adds that the side boundaries are identical. W.V Raman says that the surface is dry and so their is no lateral lovemnent for the seamers but the bowlers will get extra bounce on the pitch.

Sune Luus, the skipper of South Africa Women, she says that that they would have batted first but says that it will not change much. She adds that it is about hitting their straps and play their best cricket. She informs that they have two changes in the team.

Mithali Raj, the skipper of India Women, says that they will bat first. She adds that the yesterday’s game was played on the same track and it might help spinners. She tells that the wicket might be better when the sun is out. Says that they are focused on playing well and winning this game. Informs that they have two changes in their team.

South Africa Women (Playing XI) - Lizelle Lee, Laura Wolvaardt, Lara Goodall (In for Tazmin Brits), Sune Luus (C), Mignon du Preez, Marizanne Kapp, Chloe Tryon, Trisha Chetty (WK), Shabnim Ismail, Ayabonga Khaka, Masabata Klaas (In for Tumi Sekhukhune).

India Women (Playing XI) - Smriti Mandhana, Shafali Verma, Yastika Bhatia, Deepti Sharma (In place of Poonam Yadav), Mithali Raj (C), Harmanpreet Kaur, Richa Ghosh (WK), Pooja Vastrakar, Sneh Rana, Meghna Singh (In place of Jhulan Goswami), Rajeshwari Gayakwad.
TOSS - The coin goes up and lands in favour of India Women. They have elected to BAT first.

The Indians have been very inconsistent so far. However, they head into this game after a big win over Bangladesh. Do they have it in them to beat a side which has lost just the once in the tournament so far? We have two teams who have ensured their place in the knockouts. England are heavy favourites against Bangladesh and a win should see them through. This though is the big game, the Indians are up for a real test. Can they overcome the hurdle? We will find out. Toss in a bit.

It is time for the last game of the group stage and it is a clash between India and South Africa. It is all to play for, for the Indians, a win is must to take them through to the semi finals. South African on the other hand, will not make it easy for the Indians. They would want to head into the knockouts with winning momentum. Two sides with abundance of quality, this promises to be a cracker.
